title: RoyaScaff adapter manifest
description: The manifest `<name>.json` that sits beside an adapter's card `<name>.md` (in the engine's adapters/ folder, or in a project's project/adapters/ folder). It declares what the core must run and ask for; the core knows no stack by name. `royascaff adapter test <name>` checks a manifest against this schema. Adding a field is a minor change.

adapter.description: The adapter's name (the same as the file name).

includes.description: Adapters this one builds on; their manifests apply first.

requiresDocs.description: Layer documents a project of this kind needs (for example experience).

visualBar.description: Older spelling of personCheck for a person's look at a screen.

personLook.description: Which changes (kind, lowest risk) a person looks at before they are verified.

kind.description: What the person does: visual, transcript, demo, playtest, or your own word.

bar.description: The name of the bar the person scores against, as it is written in discovery topic 8 (for example "Usage bar").

minLines.description: The fewest lines the bar needs before the project is approved.

prompt.description: What the person is asked to do.

record.description: The APP- field whose command records what the person reads (for example a transcript).

personCheck.description: The person's check with a bar. The core knows only this shape; the kind, the bar and the prompt come from here.

requires.description: Knowledge layers every module of this stack should be described in.

checks.description: Check type -> command (unit, e2e, metric, smoke, or your own). `verify` runs the ones an app does not declare itself. An object may add a `dry` command that `adapter test` runs instead of resolving the program.

lockfiles.description: Files that pin the dependencies; they are part of an evidence fingerprint.

words.description: Technical words that must not appear in business documents (added to the card's Words).

smoke.description: A smoke check script that `royascaff smoke init` installs, with its command and the change kinds that need it.

tests.description: How to recognise test files (`files`) and tests that read source instead of running it (`readsSource`).

deps.description: How to find declared dependencies and the imports that use them.

tradeoffs.description: Patterns that show a change lowers quality; the change must say so.

extensions.description: File extensions the scan reads (with the dot).

patterns.description: Fact name -> list of regular expressions (imports, exports, routes, …). The first capture group is the fact.

schemaFiles.description: Regular expressions for schema and migration files.

scan.description: What `royascaff scan` extracts from a module of this stack.
